# Draft:Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi

Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi is the first limited series under the Star Wars: Visions Presents branding, a spinoff of the animated television series Star Wars: Visions. The series will continue the story of the short films "The Ninth Jedi" from Volume 1 and "The Ninth Jedi: Child of Hope" from Volume 3, which were written by Kenji Kamiyama and produced by Production IG. It will be released in 2026.
